description.value: Hungry Guys Kitchen is a casual downtown Vancouver eatery on Granville Street serving handcrafted burgers, salads, bowls, and burritos made from locally sourced, fresh ingredients. Founded by Aldo Velaj, who learned to cook from his mother and committed to sustainable sourcing, the 545 Granville location is the daytime counterpart to a second evening-focused location at 988 Granville. The menu is highly customizable and explicitly allergen-friendly, with staff able to accommodate dietary restrictions.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 75m; stands (6 spaces) at 83m; stands (6 spaces) at 91m; stands (3 spaces) at 95m; stands (3 spaces) at 100m. Total: 20 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a live, operating restaurant at 545 Granville St, Vancouver, BC V6Z 1L2 under the name 'Hungry Guys Kitchen' (not 'Hungry Guys Hot Pot Express' as in OSM). The phone 604-428-2625 matches OSM. The menu pages confirm online ordering (takeout) and multiple tofu/plant-based options throughout. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name 'Hungry Guys Hot Pot Express' does not match the business's own website name 'Hungry Guys Kitchen' — the OSM record may be outdated or incorrectly named. The website makes no mention of hot pot as a menu item.
OSM cuisine tag includes 'hotpot' but the website menu shows no hot pot items — only burgers, salads, bowls, and burritos.
OSM outdoor_seating=no confirmed by absence on website, but indoor_seating=yes aligns with website's 'meet up with friends' framing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant in downtown Vancouver with a confirmed website, matching address, and active menu. Useful to touring cyclists seeking a customizable, allergen-friendly meal near the Granville Street corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The 545 Granville location appears to be the casual daytime spot; the 988 Granville location is a separate evening/bar concept. This record covers 545 Granville only.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Tofu is listed as a protein option across salads, bowls, and burritos throughout the menu. Website also states 'Allergen Friendly — You can specify if you have any allergies, and we can offer alternative options.'

wow_evidence: locally sourced, fresh ingredients. Founded by Aldo Velaj
